workstream: long_loci part 8: best-window bond test on both bases (DPANN development, Spacedust check rows)
status_when_written: Parts 6-7 and both frozen runs reported. No best-window bond computed. Locked sets (lut, SR-VP) closed.
observation: audit case WA_L4b-8233: S17 directly beside L22 (rearranged S10 unit, same strand, 1 nt) in 8 of 8 group genomes and 5 other groups; bond 0.0; in the usual order (run 4346) S17 and L22 are 4 genes apart in hundreds of groups. The adaptive test scores a pair only at the smallest window containing it here, so a pair adjacent here is supported only by lineages where it is also adjacent.

variants.P-BW: family base (frozen primary of run 1): every token pair within 8 positions is tested at every window w from its own distance d up to 8: n_w = groups holding an occurrence of the pair at distance <= w (lw.bonds_adaptive's count at window w), E_w = learner expected_groups with w, Lambda_w = n ln(n/E) - n + E; the occurrence takes max_w Lambda_w over windows with n_w >= 2 and Lambda_w >= tau. tau = smallest of (4, 6, 8, 10, 12, 15, 20, 25, 30, 40, 50) with bond FDR (3 within-genome token shuffles, the same best-window procedure) <= 0.01. Everything after the bonds as the frozen primary (token cohesion, L4b tree, closed-form family node test at the bond tau); theta in {.02, .05, .1, .2}.
variants.Z-BW: list base (frozen secondary of run 1): the pairs tested are unchanged (adjacencies within <= 2 intervening genes, round-0 homolog exclusion masks K1000 as stored); for each, list-partner support is counted at every window w from 3 to 8 (partners within w positions in the other genome; E per genome min(1, 2 w c_x c_y / m), own term min(1, 2 w / m); vl group counting), and the pair takes max_w Lambda_w. tau by vl's rule applied to the whole procedure (round-0 instance FDR over 3 gene-order shuffles <= .01; ladder 4-30). Everything after the bonds as the frozen secondary (kNN cohesion, L4b+, every node kept); theta in {.02, .05, .1, .2}.
variants.unchanged: tokens, lists, groups, cohesion arrays, node rules, scorer; no bridging, no strand rule

gates.P-BW: with windows restricted to w = d only, the procedure reproduces the stored WA bonds (lw.bonds_adaptive) exactly on DPANN
